additional_analytical_decisions: Distinguish principal cash payments, noncash lease recognition, capital payables and depreciation across cash flow and nested gross/net asset disclosures. Preserve unallocated movement residuals rather than treating cash as asset additions.
reference_method: Decimal source calculations plus separate structural derivations and endpoint feasibility checks

controls.name: monetary_scale
controls.rationale: All monetary observations double, ratios and dimensionless bounds stay invariant.

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Reverse every input table. Logical financial results are unchanged.

controls.name: payable_settlement
controls.rationale: Paying an extra 1000 reduces closing capital payables by 1000. Accrual proxy unchanged.

controls.name: noncash_lease
controls.rationale: New lease recognition raises total and subset gross/net assets. Cash and residuals unchanged.

controls.name: principal_settlement
controls.rationale: Principal cash settlement changes defined cash outlay, not gross asset recognition. Lease liabilities are not supplied.

controls.name: other_cf_adjustment
controls.rationale: Unrelated other cash-flow adjustment changes, while Note 6 PPE depreciation stays fixed.

controls.name: unallocated_asset_movement
controls.rationale: A synthetic noncash gross/net PPE movement is not assigned to a cause. The total-PPE residual increases.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No model trials. Published references are a contamination risk. Development tasks only.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen scorer reused. Calibration recipe preserves qualified 3600-second, 24-turn execution.
